topics.name: Access Control
topics.definition: Identity and access management: how the respondent authenticates users, federates with an existing directory, enforces multi-factor authentication, and applies role-based or conditional access policies.

topics.name: Device Management
topics.definition: The device register and its lifecycle: onboarding, inventory, automated compliance checks, remote attestation and decommissioning of devices at volume.

topics.name: Reporting
topics.definition: Regulatory and operational reporting: dashboards, scheduled exports, structured data extracts aligned to a regulator's schema, and the audit trails behind them.

topics.name: Hosting
topics.definition: Where the solution runs: sovereign or government-region cloud hosting, data centre accreditation, and whether data is pinned to the domestic jurisdiction or transferred across a border.

topics.name: Support
topics.definition: Support and maintenance of the delivered solution: coverage hours, response and resolution targets, and ongoing maintenance obligations.

topics.name: Delivery
topics.definition: How the work is delivered: phasing, milestones, proof-of-concept commitments and the delivery risk the respondent carries.

topics.name: Compliance
topics.definition: Declared compliance posture: national security accreditation, security certifications held, ownership and control of the respondent, and any accreditation it does not hold.
